title: Pulmonary Pathophysiology
description: Infectious, obstructive, restrictive, inflammatory, malignant, vascular, and sleep-related pulmonary disorders with diagnosis, signs and symptoms, treatment, and respiratory therapy considerations.

lessons.title: Infectious Pulmonary Diseases
lessons.description: Pneumonia and tuberculosis: causes, classifications, pathogenesis, signs and symptoms, diagnosis, treatment, and infection control concerns.

lessons.title: Obstructive Pulmonary Diseases
lessons.description: COPD, cystic fibrosis, chronic bronchitis, asthma, bronchiectasis, and emphysema, including PFT patterns, structural changes, symptoms, diagnosis, and treatment.

lessons.title: Restrictive Pulmonary Disorders
lessons.description: Restrictive disease patterns, pleural disorders, interstitial lung disease, neuromuscular causes, stroke-related respiratory complications, and chest wall disorders.

resources.title: Tension Pneumothorax Signs
resources.description: Video reference linked in the source material for tension pneumothorax assessment.

resources.title: Bronchopleural Fistula
resources.description: Video reference linked in the source material for bronchopleural fistula and large air leaks.

resources.description: Reference linked in the source material for the Tensilon test in myasthenia gravis.

resources.title: Respiratory Muscle Monitoring
resources.description: Video reference linked in the source material for VC, MIP, and MEP monitoring.

resources.title: Neurologic Diagnostic Tests
resources.description: Reference linked in the source material for spinal tap, electromyography, and nerve conduction studies.

resources.title: Sniff Test

resources.title: Diaphragmatic Plication
resources.description: Reference linked in the source material for surgical plication of the affected diaphragm.

lessons.title: ARDS & Lung Cancer

lessons.title: Pulmonary Vascular Disease

resources.description: Video reference linked in the source material for pulmonary hypertension.
